propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs N-unmet) for identical inputs, code, and criteria across runs, making the close gate unreliable.
The instability is concentrated in test-existence crediting: criteria phrased as '... regression test / guard test' are false-negatived on some runs while the implementation assessment stays stable.

Root cause is the verifier agent's variable free-form search: search_files is a literal case-sensitive substring tool, but the agent sometimes issues regex/semantic queries that all no-match and concludes the test does not exist.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar is too slim to diagnose the flakiness because it does not record verified_at_sha, trace_id, or input snapshot, so non-determinism cannot be distinguished from input drift from stored data.
Fix pins verifier sampling temperature to 0 by default unless REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE is explicitly set, mirroring the plan-review Pass-2 greedy pin.
Fix records verified_at_sha and trace_id on both PASS and FAIL sidecar payloads and adds prompt guidance to locate tests by ticket-id and exact symbol rather than semantic/regex search.
